biology.crops-prac-reliab.0002.a: To identify anomalous results; calculate a mean so results more reliable/repeatable
biology.crops-prac-reliab.0002.b: Plants grown with no fertiliser (0 g) under same conditions; to compare and show any effect is due to fertiliser

biology.crops-prac-risk.0001.a: e.g. paraffin heater / hot equipment burns or fumes - keep away/ventilate; or soil microorganisms - wear gloves/wash hands
biology.crops-prac-risk.0001.b: Use a balance with greater resolution / remove soil and blot water before weighing / weigh all lettuces and find mean

biology.crops-prac-step.0003.all: Water is a control variable; water affects growth (photosynthesis/ion uptake) so only fertiliser affects yield - fair test

biology.crops-prac-vars.0002.b: yield / mass of tomatoes (or plant height)
biology.crops-prac-vars.0002.c: volume of water; light intensity; temperature; variety of tomato; type/volume of compost

biology.crops-recall.0004.all: Pests damage/eat crops and reduce yield

biology.cycles-describe.0003.all: Decomposers (bacteria/fungi) break down protein; produce ammonium compounds (ammonification); nitrifying bacteria convert ammonium to nitrite then nitrate

biology.cycles-describe-multi.0008.b: Decomposers convert protein to ammonium; nitrifying bacteria convert ammonium to nitrite and then nitrate

biology.cycles-explain.0005.all: Cold: decomposer enzymes work slowly, less kinetic energy so fewer collisions; dry: decomposers need water for reactions/growth/to secrete enzymes; so microorganisms respire and reproduce slowly

biology.cycles-explain-multi.0005.b: At night no light so no photosynthesis; respiration continues releasing CO2; CO2 not absorbed so builds up

biology.cycles-ext.0011.all: Manure/compost contain proteins and urea; decomposers break down into ammonium; nitrifying bacteria (aerobic) convert ammonium to nitrite then nitrate; compost improves aeration/drainage favouring nitrifying bacteria and reducing denitrifying bacteria; plants absorb nitrate by active transport to make amino acids/proteins

biology.cycles-mcq-rev.0001.all: Removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere

biology.division-variation-data-graph.00.a: As dose increases number of mutant colonies increases (quote data)
biology.division-variation-data-graph.00.b: UV is a mutagen; damages DNA / changes base sequence; higher dose more mutations; mutant cells divide by binary fission/mitosis forming colonies

biology.division-variation-data-pct.0003.b: Same variety so genetically similar/same genes; differences in height caused by environment (nitrate); nitrate used for proteins so growth; levels off as another factor limits

biology.division-variation-data-plot.000.a: Axes with labels/units; linear scale; points plotted; smooth curve
biology.division-variation-data-plot.000.b: Height increases with nitrate, rate of increase slows, levels off at 46 cm from 40 g per m2

biology.division-variation-data-read.000.b: (h40 - h10)/30 cm per g per m2
biology.division-variation-data-read.000.c: Same variety so genetic variation minimal; variation due to environment

biology.division-variation-describe.0004.all: Grow genetically identical plants (clones) in different conditions - differences due to environment; grow different varieties in identical conditions - differences due to genes; measure heights and compare

biology.division-variation-describe-mult.b: Chromosomes replicate (copy) before division; line up at the equator; chromatids separate to opposite poles; each new cell gets same number of chromosomes (diploid)

biology.division-variation-explain.0006.all: Mutation changes base sequence of gene; changes amino acid sequence; changes shape of active site so substrate no longer fits

biology.division-variation-explain-multi.b: X-rays are ionising radiation and cause mutations/cancer; lead absorbs X-rays

biology.division-variation-mcq.0004.all: they have no effect on the phenotype

biology.division-variation-mcq-rev.0005.all: Can change features such as body mass and scars

biology.division-variation-recall.0001.all: Having one set of chromosomes (half the diploid number), as in gametes

biology.crops-prac-risk.0001.fix: Change 'student' to 'grower'; mark scheme b: use a balance with higher resolution / remove soil and excess water before weighing / weigh several lettuces and find a mean.
